properties.description: A decomposition is asked what it dropped: the question fires per decomposed parent and names the parent; a requirement nobody split is silent; only DECOMPOSES counts, so satisfaction and derivation never raise it; the recorded answer stops the question and survives in reviewed_gaps; CHANGING THE SPLIT RE-ASKS with a new id, because the earlier answer was about those children; a parent already reporting delivered outranks one still open AND says so; and the finding NEVER names what is missing (crates/reflow2-core/tests/detect.rs, 7 cases).
properties.findings: MUTATION-CHECKED FIVE WAYS, each killed by exactly the test that names it: dropping the detector registration (5 dead), flipping is_aggregate to true so a stale answer silences a changed split (1), anchoring only the parent (2), removing the delivered severity bump (1), and making the finding suggest what to add (1).
properties.name: A decomposition is asked what it dropped
